name: Michigan Math and Science Scholars (MMSS)
org: University of Michigan, College of Literature, Science, and the Arts
what_you_do: Two-week summer courses in math and science taught by U-M Ph.D. faculty. You take one course per session, with hands-on work, and can live in a dorm or commute. You can attend one, two or three sessions.
who_can_apply: Rising sophomores, juniors or seniors in high school. You must have finished at least one year of high school. Students from any country may apply.
pay_detail: 2026 costs per session: $1,400 tuition, plus $1,100 to live on campus with meals. $100 application fee that is not refunded. Some financial aid is available.
duration: Two-week sessions. 2027: June 20 to July 2, July 4 to July 16, and July 18 to July 30
deadline_text: The 2027 application opens in mid-January 2027 (exact date not posted). Admission is rolling until courses fill, so apply early.
how_to_apply: Apply online with a transcript or grade report, one teacher recommendation (math or science preferred), a personal statement and the $100 fee. GPA and test scores are not needed. Join the mailing list on the home page for updates.
notes: Classes run Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. The fee page still shows 2026 prices; 2027 prices may differ. Weekend trips and airport rides cost extra.
